Commands below come from the awdk README as summarized on [[Company Brain/awdk|awdk]]. Check that page and the upstream README for the current versions.

<span id="prerequisites"></span>
== Prerequisites ==

* Python 3.10 or later
* A machine you control. The tools detect your hardware and pull local models, or you can use a hosted back end (see [[Company Brain/Bring your own model|Bring your own model]]).

<span id="install-and-first-run"></span>
== Install and first run ==

<syntaxhighlight lang="bash">pip install awdk                      # or: uv tool install awdk, for the CLI
adk quickstart                        # detects hardware, pulls models, configures backends
adk init my-agent && cd my-agent && python agent.py</syntaxhighlight>
<span id="add-a-discord-front-end"></span>
== Add a Discord front end ==

See [[Company Brain/awdiscord|awdiscord]] and the [[Company Brain/Guide: setting up your company brain in Discord|setup guide]]. Note that connecting awbrain to awdiscord is marked there as a proposal that has not been tested.
